meta.description: Professional football coaching at Maple Grove High School. Offensive expertise, personalized training, and real results.

about.name: Coach Jared Martinson
about.title: TEs/RGC/Playcaller
about.bio:
Coach Jared Martinson brings 5 years of experience running the Multiple system at Maple Grove High School. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Martinson is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the Varsity level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Martinson delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: Maple Grove High School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Multiple System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Multiple offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
